town_description: Siliguri is the gateway city of North Bengal, sitting on the narrow Siliguri Corridor linking mainland India with the Northeast. A busy trade and transport hub, it connects the plains to Darjeeling, Sikkim, Bhutan and Nepal, with Bagdogra airport and New Jalpaiguri railway station nearby.
